stable.label: iOS 27
stable.notes: Major release introducing Siri AI (next-gen Apple Intelligence), faster app launches / Photos / AirDrop, stronger parental controls, and many refinements. Compatible with iPhone 11 and later. Full Siri AI and some Apple Intelligence features require A17 Pro or newer.

upcomingFeature.label: iOS 27.1
upcomingFeature.notes: Expected to expand Siri AI languages (FR/JA/KO/PT/ES), more Apple Cash / RCS features, and polish. Date is community estimate — check Settings > General > Software Update.

beta.label: iOS 27.2 (beta)
beta.notes: Developer beta. Early work for the post-27.1 release. Not recommended on a daily driver.

communitySentiment.label: Mostly positive after first week
communitySentiment.summary: Launch-week reports (Wi-Fi drops, Bluetooth pairing, Face ID false rejects on newest Pros) largely quieted after a few days. Temporary battery/indexing hit is normal. Siri AI reception is strong on supported chips; older devices get performance and security benefits without the full AI suite.
communitySentiment.sourceNote: Synthesized from Apple Newsroom, developer release notes, MacRumors forums, Reddit r/ios, and recent YouTube tech-reviewer comments (as of 24 Sep 2026).

updateProbability.label: Reasonably safe to update for most users

breakdown.note: Featured as stable major release; no critical 'do not install' advisory.
Launch bugs acknowledged; most report smooth experience after 3–5 days. 27.0.1 expected soon for remaining Face ID edge cases.
Mixed early threads (battery, keyboard lag) but volume of complaints dropped sharply after day 5–7.
Major channels recommend updating on A16+ hardware; advise waiting 1–2 weeks on older chips if battery life is critical.
First week of any major iOS is the riskiest window; risk falls quickly once the first point release appears.

adviceByTier.ai: High confidence — update now if you want Siri AI and the full feature set.
adviceByTier.mid: Good confidence — safe for most; wait a few more days only if you need absolute maximum battery life this week.
adviceByTier.entry: Moderate confidence — the update is supported and brings security fixes, but older chips feel early-release slowdowns more. Waiting for 27.0.1 / 27.1 is the lower-risk path.

pointReleaseAdvice: Major .0 releases carry the highest early risk. Point releases bring bug/security fixes with lower risk. If you are not in a hurry and your device is older, waiting 7–14 days (or until the first point release) is a proven strategy.
